coverage.summary: One fresh official equity-research/market-analytics role verified. Mercy Corps' same-day/conflicting deadlines, closed graduate schemes and inaccessible Rozee detail were excluded. No freshly verifiable live VC/PE investment internship found; remote Pakistan does not establish Indian work eligibility.

Four distinct finance/accounting internships verified, including CAL's investment-bank finance team. Local job-board full details were inspected alongside direct employer email/form routes; EDOTCO duplicates consolidated. Nationality/sponsorship are unstated, so Indian eligibility is not asserted. No new dated VC/PE seat verified.

Six distinct internships verified across research-institute finance, corporate finance, market-infrastructure KYC and stockbroker documentation. IWMI is Sri Lankan-only; other adverts do not establish cross-border eligibility. Current LSEG requisition confirmed through rendered Workday. No fresh live VC/PE investing internship verified.

Five distinct credit, operations and microfinance assistant posts verified from original employer posters and application routes. All require Nepali citizenship; three require prior financial-sector experience. Original posters corrected local-board age/application-link errors. Nepali-calendar source dates retained without inventing Gregorian employer publication dates.

No fresh, publicly verifiable live early-career finance/VC/PE opening admitted. Bank of Bhutan, Gerab Financials, Bhutan Insurance, Bhutan Telecom and broader public-policy searches produced closed rounds, selection results, unrelated engineering or senior roles. This is a researched coverage gap, not a claim that Bhutan has no opportunities.

One fresh pension investment-analyst notice verified in the official Government Gazette, including salary, deadline and application-login route. The required Maldivian citizenship card prevents assuming Indian eligibility. TOR was unreadable; its extra duties/requirements are not invented. Startup funding and stale hotel-internship mirrors excluded.
